description: SYNTHETIC DATA. Invented historical exception cases. Reviewer identifiers are fictitious.

records.description: Upstream product Revolving Credit was booked downstream as TERM.
records.confirmed_root_cause: Product mapping PRODMAP-v1 mapped Revolving Credit to TERM (mapping defect).
records.resolution: Facility type confirmed as revolving against the executed facility agreement. Servicing corrected the Loan IQ product. Mapping defect raised with the integration team.

records.description: Upstream approved amount exceeded the downstream facility amount by USD 5,000,000.
records.confirmed_root_cause: Commitment reduction amendment was processed in Loan IQ, but the origination record was not updated.
records.resolution: Upstream record updated after confirming the executed amendment. Downstream record left unchanged.

records.description: Downstream booking failed with a missing pricing option error.
records.confirmed_root_cause: Pricing option for a new benchmark rate had not been set up in servicing static data.
records.resolution: Static data team added the pricing option. Booking resubmitted successfully.

records.description: Downstream maturity date differed from the upstream approved maturity date by 30 days.
records.confirmed_root_cause: Manual keying error at booking (day field).
records.resolution: Downstream maturity corrected to the Termination Date in the facility agreement.

records.description: Upstream Bridge Loan was booked downstream as TERM.
records.resolution: Closed without root cause after the borrower prepaid the facility in full.
